stage_transitions.friction_pattern: Qualified accounts sit uncontacted for ~34 days before being lost — pre-Discovery inertia is the dominant leak point across the entire funnel.
stage_transitions.evidence: 140 losses at this stage, 0 wins recorded. Median 34 days to loss. 114 closed-lost as 'Cold' — the largest single reason in the dataset — almost certainly originate here before a Discovery Call is ever booked.
stage_transitions.play: Implement a 72-hour SLA from Qualified Account creation: auto-enrol in a 3-touch sequence (call attempt D1, SMS D2, personalised NRM-region ACCU estimate email D3). Flag any account >5 days uncontacted as a rep-level escalation in CRM.

stage_transitions.friction_pattern: No transition data available — stage may be collapsed in practice, bypassed, or not yet tracked with sufficient volume to produce signal.
stage_transitions.evidence: 0 won, 0 lost, median days 0 for both sides. Cannot distinguish whether Discovery-to-Strategy is a same-session handoff or a data-capture gap in the CRM pipeline.
stage_transitions.play: Audit CRM stage usage for the last 90 days: confirm whether 'Discovery Call' is being logged as a discrete stage or merged into Strategy Call. If merged, separate them and instrument a 48-hour Strategy Call booking rate KPI from Discovery completion.

stage_transitions.friction_pattern: Landholder intent collapses rapidly after Strategy Call — won deals advance in 3 days while lost deals drift 36 days before dying, indicating a failure to capture commitment or create urgency at call close.
stage_transitions.evidence: 34 won vs 57 lost. Won median 3 days, lost median 36 days — a 12x gap. 45 losses coded 'Not for at least 6 months' and 9 coded '25 years, too long' likely crystallise here as the 25-year ERF commitment is first presented in detail.
stage_transitions.play: On every Strategy Call, close with a live screen-share of a property-matched 25-year ACCU projection using NRM region and land area. Send the PDF within 2 hours post-call with a calendar link for SLA/KCT Mapping booked within 7 days. No projection sent = no progression.

stage_transitions.friction_pattern: Baseline sampling cost and implementation burden stall deals during mapping — slower velocity to loss (~23 extra days) suggests progressive disengagement rather than a hard stop, pointing to cost objection or agronomic complexity.
stage_transitions.evidence: 23 won vs 30 lost. Won median 41 days, lost median 64 days — 1.56x gap. 'Baseline costs too high' (5) and 'No agronomy expertise' (6) surface as specific loss reasons consistent with friction at the mapping/KCT design stage.
stage_transitions.play: At SLA/KCT Mapping initiation, send a one-page 'Baseline Cost vs Projected ACCU Revenue' payback calculator pre-populated with the property's NRM region and hectarage. Flag any deal >45 days in mapping for a proactive agronomy-support call to address implementation barriers before KCT is drafted.

stage_transitions.friction_pattern: KCT expiry or landholder cold-feet post-issuance causes protracted losses — won deals close in 17 days while lost deals drag 126 days, suggesting KCTs are being issued to insufficiently committed landholders or follow-up cadence drops off.
stage_transitions.evidence: 23 won vs 15 lost. Won median 17 days, lost median 126 days — a 7.4x gap. 'Insufficient commitment to implement' (29 total) likely concentrates here. Competitor losses (7) may also manifest at contract-review stage.
stage_transitions.play: Set a hard 30-day KCT acceptance window: at issuance, send a countersigned cover letter stating the KCT terms are valid for 30 days, with a day-10 and day-20 rep call. Any KCT unaccepted at day-30 triggers a 'commit or close' call before the deal is marked lost — not after 126 days of drift.

top_systemic_friction: Pre-Discovery inertia is the single largest revenue leak: 140 accounts lost before a Discovery Call is ever completed, with 'Cold' accounting for 114 closed-lost reasons overall. Fixing the Qualified Account → Discovery Call SLA and contact cadence will have more pipeline impact than optimising any downstream stage.
era_lift_observation: Legacy era accounts for 268 of 351 total records (76%), dominating all conversion benchmarks. KCT Process era (44 records) represents the cleanest signal for current-state performance analysis. Stormboy v2 (11 records) is too thin for reliable pattern detection — prioritise KCT Process cohort for playbook validation.
